milestone: A25: ordinary array-CV table counts across lossy-float literal keys
status: independently reviewed private publication; awaiting exact-parent composition
scope: By-value array-literal elements with ordinary defined CV values and finite fitting lossy-float ordinary CV keys. Initial and resumed value cells are allocated, unmarked, unblocked/unreleased and carry no type/coercion/backing receipts; their tables are mutable nonpool flat DIRECT null/bool/int/float arrays.

The continuation owns the actual pre-conversion HARRAY, not the original CV cell. Same-table insertion transfers that owner even after the old CV cell retires. Different-table insertion uses the live CV table without a new native ADDREF: LITERALARRAYRETAINED preserves the old count and LITERALARRAYDEBTS subtracts the missing new-table count, independently of CELL biases.

Fresh normal, same-table, entry-deletion and supplied-throw programs keep positive effective counts. Shared writes at physical count1 persist after the selected entry or builder disappears; inverse retargeting cancels both table biases before restored ordinary COW and teardown. This is pinned engine behavior, not a confirmed engine-bug claim or intentional divergence.
lifetime: Both debt families use the existing pre-owner/direct-prune sticky lifetime guard. First prune the logical graph with all debts cleared; every debt target must survive with ordinary owners greater than its debt multiplicity. New HARRAY targets are flat leaves, so positive subtraction creates no outgoing-edge cascade. The independent lost-owner control retains a raw unreachable CV edge but logical pruning removes it and rejects zero effective count before allocations change. No effective-zero native program is run.
boundaries: Initially wrapped CVs, mixed scalar/array retargets, pooled/immutable or nested/reference-bearing/string-leaf tables and other owning CV values remain Unsupported. Builders are object-free and distinct from both tables. Active collection and outstanding request-end debt remain refused; paused undefined-reference LIST, owned-NUL include and active lifecycle/class scopes are untouched.
implementation: Seven runtime files add the distinct task/table fields, HARRAY root/debt mapping, combined safety dispatch, keyed-producer exclusions, metadata validation, compiler-image isolation and bounded producer. Graph ownership/prune algorithms and prior wrapper protocols are unchanged. Empty new fields add no nodes and reduce combined guards to prior CELL behavior; no historical PHP/test edits or evidence renewal.
